name: Jax Okonkwo
bio: Pilot; flies the approach and docking on every hop.
voice: Easy, cocky, pilot slang and understatement: a near miss is "a bit of a wobble". Calls the captain "Skipper" and means it kindly. Jokes first, facts second, and the facts are usually good. Bad news he shrugs off out loud while his hands are already on the controls.
